# Nex-N2.6

Nex-AGI · released 2026-11

Nex-AGI fine-tune of GLM-5.3-Flash (MoE), successor to Nex-N2.5-Pro, focused on computer use, coding and long-horizon tool use; image input. Repo (created 2026-11-10) holds FP8 weights (328.3 GB); card results are 'model-level results, not a separate evaluation of this FP8 export'. The card's self-hosting route is the GLM-5.3-Flash SGLang guide with the model path replaced (no copy-pasteable command), so local routes use bartowski's GGUF quants. reasoning\_effort low/high/max, default max. No official Ollama entry (404). Card states no context length. Licence: No LICENSE file in the repo at 9874722; licence from the card metadata 'license: apache-2.0'. Base model GLM-5.3-Flash is MIT per the DB. API price: No first-party price; OpenRouter prices are not an allowed price source.

[Model and usage documentation](https://huggingface.co/nex-agi/Nex-N2.6)

[Catalogue source](https://huggingface.co/nex-agi/Nex-N2.6/blob/987472298e7867721576ac49a253a6f5b526013e/README.md)

## How to run it

### Through an API

api (OpenRouter (the API link on the Nex-AGI card)) · price unknown · [openrouter.ai](https://openrouter.ai/nex-agi/nex-n2.6)

### llama.cpp (recommended)

1. Install llama.cpp. Homebrew and winget installs name the commands llama-cli and llama-server instead. [Other ways to install](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/blob/master/docs/install.md)
   
   ```sh
   # macOS / Linux
   curl -LsSf https://llama.app/install.sh | sh
   # Windows
   irm https://llama.app/install.ps1 | iex
   ```

2. Run Nex-N2.6 (Q4_K_M, needs 214 GB memory, 202 GB download, from [huggingface.co/bartowski](https://huggingface.co/bartowski/Nex-N2.6-GGUF/blob/e7959c745fec0feb1e705c592a27938a9ed1ee1b/README.md))
   
   ```sh
   llama cli -hf bartowski/Nex-N2.6-GGUF:Q4_K_M
   ```

3. Or start a local server and open the address it prints (http://localhost:9931)
   
   ```sh
   llama serve -hf bartowski/Nex-N2.6-GGUF:Q4_K_M
   ```

Other versions: IQ2_XXS (104 GB memory, 97.8 GB download) `llama cli -hf bartowski/Nex-N2.6-GGUF:IQ2_XXS`

### LM Studio

1. Install LM Studio. Open the app once before using the lms command. [Download it (macOS / Windows / Linux)](https://lmstudio.ai/download)

2. Run Nex-N2.6 (Q4_K_M, needs 214 GB memory, 202 GB download, from [huggingface.co/bartowski](https://huggingface.co/bartowski/Nex-N2.6-GGUF/blob/e7959c745fec0feb1e705c592a27938a9ed1ee1b/README.md))
   
   ```sh
   lms get https://huggingface.co/bartowski/Nex-N2.6-GGUF@Q4_K_M -y
   ```

3. Then run lms ls to see its name, and lms chat followed by that name

Other versions: IQ2_XXS (104 GB memory, 97.8 GB download) `lms get https://huggingface.co/bartowski/Nex-N2.6-GGUF@IQ2_XXS -y`
